title: Chapter 759
paragraphs: Chapter 759
186. Bamel Alliance and the Head of the Minte Blacksmith Association's Double Celebration (2)
The eyes of Fire, Hammer, and Anvil grew large in surprise.
"You can fix Bailam!?"
"Is, is that really possible?"
"You seem unaware. Our Bamel Alliance has a device called a chaos purifier. It can almost perfectly purify the chaos erosion without physical transformation."
[Peee, peee……]
Bailam moaned and sank back into the water. It seemed even lifting itself out of the water briefly was strenuous.
"It's not without variables. I've never confirmed whether the device works perfectly against monsters, and the size of the body is quite large."
It was their first time dealing with a case where the spirit of a monster was eroded by chaos, rather than being enhanced by it.
"Master, please help us! If you can do that."
"If I do?"
When Jin interrupted and asked, the executives flinched and glanced at each other.
"……We will make a sword for the master."
It may sound modest, but it was not. It meant that all of the world's best blacksmiths (excluding Picon) would work together to make a single sword.
"I could just ask Picon for that. Do Picon and I seem to have just a casual relationship?"
Of course, even if the three executives combined their strength, they could not match Picon.
"That's not it."
[We have a very deep relationship. If it wasn't for Master, I would still be hiding inside that empty guy.]
"Ahem! Then, what do you want?"
"Nothing in particular."
"Nothing? Then why?"
"You were the one who talked as if you were going to give something, Fire. I was just planning to do a favor. However."
"However?"
"If you really want to return the favor, how about joining the Bamel Alliance?"
"Are you asking for an exclusive contract?"

"I know well that the association is a neutral force that does not interfere with world affairs. But it's not the time to remain neutral anymore. Anyone with capabilities needs to take sides now. That's why even the Unseen Bow and Nameless had to abandon their long traditions and gather under the flag of the alliance."
The association has never belonged to any faction since its establishment.
The executives' eyes became serious. However, that grave atmosphere didn't stem from displeasure or worry about the proposal.
"……Wasn't the answer to that issue decided the moment Picon came to us?"
"As you can see, Picon is an absolute entity to us. It's not just a symbolic story, he has actually become the god of blacksmiths. Picon's will is our will."
"As I just said, since Master Picon already has a deep relationship with us, isn't our joining the alliance a natural step?"
"It's a satisfying answer, but it seems too quick to accept."
"We were somewhat prepared as well. We're not entirely indifferent to the world's affairs."
"If we have to choose a side, we concluded that it should be Runekandel or the Bamel Alliance rather than Jifle. Blacksmiths naturally fit better with knights than mages."
Fire extended his hand to Jin with a sly smile.
"We look forward to working with you. Although we have already made our decision, to be honest, we were not entirely pleased as it was a choice we had to make."
"So that's why you were rude when I arrived?"
"We're always like that. Anyway, meeting you in person today, it doesn't seem like such a bad thing."
"It's not just 'not bad'. You'll think it's fortunate that you chose me."
Jin also smiled and shook Fire's hand. Now that they were family, he used honorific language.

[It's good to see. Well, since the conversation seems to be over, let's help that guy Bailam first. From what I hear, if that guy's not around, not only the association, but also the Bamel Alliance's plans will face many difficulties.]
Physical changes can happen instantly if unlucky, so they had to hurry. He had taken over the association just a few hours after arriving on the island, but there was no time to bask in joy.
"I'll go to Tikan and bring the purifier. It seems too difficult to take Bailam to Tikan. Master Sirius, let's go."

Picon immediately headed to Tikan on a moat. Luckily, the moat was in much better condition after the Temple of Evil Gods, so there were no major problems with consecutive long-distance teleportations.
"Master? You're back already?"
"Yeah, Gillie. Things went very well."
"Oh, as expected of our Master!"
"Jet, bring the chaos purifier. We have to go again."
While Jet was moving, Jin explained the situation to his colleagues. It was so simple that there was no need to summarize.
"This time, let's take Hedo Kyung together. We'll need Kyung's strength."
"Alright."
Sandra, who happened to be out for a walk with Veil, didn't make a fuss about wanting to join them.
[Boo, wooong…….]
When they arrived back on the island, Moat slumped down, catching its breath.
"You're here!"

When they lowered the purifier into the underground, the executives tilted their heads in half belief. They didn't doubt the purifier's performance, they just couldn't visualize this small device handling Bailam's gigantic body.
"Fire, blow the horn again and call Bailam."

As the sound of the horn echoed, Bailam reacted noticeably slower than before and emerged on the surface of the water. Hedo jumped into the sea and tied a prepared rope around Bailam's body. Sirius used the power of ice magic to create a large ice sheet under the water for Hedo to stand on.
"Jin, pull!"
Hedo pushed Bailam from below, and Jin kept pulling. They were trying to extract this massive creature using pure physical strength alone.
Shuuuk-!
A moment later, like a radish being pulled out, Bailam was lifted above the opening.
"Ah, Bailam!"
"Get a grip!"
The executives hugged Bailam and made a fuss, but Jin was relieved to see that its condition wasn't bad.
"This is the initial stage of corrosion. If we do well, it could be purified within a few days... no, even by today. As long as the purifier works properly on the monster."
He attached the wires of the purifier to various parts of Bailam's body. The device began to vibrate immediately, and a murky energy began to be absorbed into the wires.
Every five minutes, Jin and Hedo put Bailam back in the water. Its energy had weakened, so it couldn't stay out of water for long.
The strenuous purification process continued until midnight.
[This is the first monster that the Master of Runekandel and the world's strongest strength user have painstakingly tamed.]
Even if it took a month instead of a day, it was worth it. There was the practical benefit of gaining near-infinite sea power, but Bailam was also as much a member of the alliance as the association.
As the last chaotic energy left through the wires, Bailam's skin began to gleam.
Bailam, now free of the mold-like chaotic energy, didn't look like a monster at all. It looked just like a beautiful, glowing white whale.
"... If this is a monster, then what was wrong with those things I was rolling around with in the Black Sea?"
Even Hedo, who boasts of having the most experience with monsters in Sesung, had never seen such a beautiful monster.
"Well..."
[Pipipipi! Pipi!]
Bailam, having regained its energy, let out a pleasant cry. Its wriggling motion, rubbing its body, was undoubtedly a sign of gratitude.
[You, benefactor, I, repay favor!]
Jin had heard during the treatment that it had learned some human language from the blacksmiths. Jin chuckled at Bailam's words.
The blacksmiths were very tearful. They cried as they told Bailam various things.
"Keep gathering the sea power like now and deliver it to the blacksmiths."
[Understood, but, something, lacking!]
"Do you know where the Black Emperor Star is?"
[I know!]
"How many days do you need to swim there?"
"Three days."
"With the full amount of sea power you can carry?"
[Still three days.]
"How much can you carry?"
[My, body weight, about!]
"Isn't that hard?"
[Eating cooled rice. Pipipipit. Light, walk!]
Jin clapped his hands without realizing it.
If what Bailam said was true, not only was the iron supply issue solved, but also the transportation to the Black Emperor Territory, all at once.
And because it was undersea transportation, there was almost no chance of being exposed to enemies.
'Three days, no. If I generously consider a week, and every time I can move a weight of purified sea power similar to Bailam's to the Black Emperor Territory...'
There would be no shortage of steel. Without even considering cost-cutting, they could pour as much steel into shipbuilding and still have leftovers.
Not only Bailam, but also the transportation of steel within the empire was planned, which was perfect for deceiving the eyes of the enemies.
[Is that, all I, have to do!?]
"Yes. When I'm ready, I'll tell you. Then you can help."
[Okay! I'm, hungry, going to, eat!]
Splash!
Bailam threw himself into the sea below the opening. The blacksmiths, drenched in seawater because of that, seemed to be in a good mood nonetheless.
"Bailam has never broken a promise, Master."
"Neither has our association."
"Considering what you said to Bailam, I guess I can vaguely see what you want, Master. You seem to be planning to mass-produce a fleet."
"That's correct."
"If you give us the parts blueprint, we will send you as much as needed in the shape you need. It will be much better if we send it so that it can be received on-site and easily reprocessed."
The association isn't only good at blacksmithing. In any area of metal processing, no one could follow the blacksmiths of the association.

The Barmel Alliance secured the core materials for shipbuilding and exclusive blacksmiths, the association rescued a friend and regained infinite sea power. The party took out a bottle of liquor and had a short celebration. Everyone had a lot of work to do.
"I'm going back now. Pi-kon, you will be staying here from now on."
[That's right. When you go back, send me my hammer and goods. Hedo's 7th class sword is almost completed, so I'll let you know when it's finished.]
As they were about to ride the moat to return, Bailam leaped from the sea and waved goodbye.
Along with a warm feeling, he remembered those who had not yet returned.
'I need to go find Runtia sister and Lurette now.'
